title: 汎用直立アーケード筐体
description: 遊戯施設や交流ラウンジ用に自作した汎用の直立ゲーム筐体。傾いた無表示画面と厚い枠、段付き操作面、固定ジョイスティックとボタン、硬貨口風の前面金具、背面サービス扉・通気部・電源口を造形。既存ゲームの画面・キャラクター・ロゴ・ブランドは使用していません。画面表示、入力、遊戯ソフト、電装・課金機能は含まず、実機性能や安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.726 × 1.873 × 0.863 m、10,448三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: An originally designed upright arcade-cabinet prop for recreation venues and community lounges. It has a tilted blank display with thick bezel, stepped control deck, fixed joystick and buttons, coin-slot-like front fittings, rear service door, vents and power-inlet exterior. No existing game screens, characters, logos or brands are used. Display output, inputs, game software, electrical and payment functions are absent; real-device performance and safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.726 × 1.873 × 0.863 m; 10,448 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
